1.2.4.2-f22.text: de mania; Haud postrema causa supputatur educatio, inter has mentis abalienationis causas. Injusta noverca

translations.literal: on mania; not the last cause is reckoned education, among these causes of alienation of mind. Unjust stepmother.
translations.note: 'de mania' belongs to the citation ('chapter on mania') rather than to the quotation itself. 'Injusta noverca' seems to be a separate catchword (the harsh stepmother of proverb), matching the 'stepmothers' in Burton's text.
